title: ldmgen: a generator-neutral event record for light-dark-matter simulation
description: ldmgen defines a generator-neutral event record for light-dark-matter production and scattering (ldmgen/1, HDF5), with adapters for BdNMC and similar generators, comparison tools, a public interchange layer on HepMC3 with a thin LdmHepMC attribute profile, and HEPEVT sinks for experiment simulations.
